name: Orbit Gallery
description: A circular image gallery for React: photos ride a slowly turning ring, lift out on hover, spin with the wheel or a drag (with momentum), and open into the middle on click with a caption. Springs only, no dependencies.

props.name: items
props.description: The images. Title and caption show under an opened image.

props.name: ringSize
props.description: Ring diameter as a share of the component's shorter side.

props.name: cardSize
props.description: Card width as a share of the shorter side.

props.name: drift
props.description: Auto-rotation in degrees per second. 0 holds the ring still. Pauses on hover.

props.name: wheelSpin
props.description: The mouse wheel or trackpad spins the ring (and the page doesn't scroll while over it).

props.name: openSize
props.description: Width of an opened image as a share of the shorter side.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards, in px; stays the same on screen as they scale.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
